ChangeNotes.Value:
v2.0.0 - the biggest release since the mod was born.
MARRIAGE BY COURTSHIP * Court anyone in conversation - their heart walks its own road: liking, love, readiness, betrothal, wedding * They write their OWN misgivings about a life with you, in their own words - only they decide when one is answered * Station guards the hand: a great house's daughter may love anyone, but her hand asks a suitor of standing * Noble kin must bless - a bride-price haggled in talk or by letter * Companion brides and grooms (vanilla forbids them; here they are the point) * The wedding is the real game marriage - cutscene, clan, children * Nothing is sealed by words alone: every step takes your confirming click * Offers ride letters too. Plays well with Marry Anyone
THE BATTLE CHRONICLE * Every battle you fight is set down - both armies, the fallen, prisoners, spoils, plunder, renown * Field, siege, hideout and sea-fights alike (War Sails included) * Battles earn names by their deeds: 'The Grand Victory near Ortysia, over Thrice Our Number' * Everyone who fought at your side remembers it in the first person - what their own hand did, how they came out * Ask them later: 'what happened at the storming of Varcheg?' * Characters know their own wounds now - and see yours * Drills from the Training Battles mod are never mistaken for real war
THE ROAD JOURNAL * Companions riding with you witness the stops: what you traded, the men you hired, the captives you sold * And the tasks you carry, with their deadlines - and how each one ended
HIRING BY HANDSHAKE * Agree service and price with a wanderer in the talk itself; only your click hires * Haggling within honest bounds; the daily wage is never negotiable * Sellswords open at their worth and never volunteer their lowest price * Characters know their own gear - no more promised bows they never owned
THE DIRECTOR'S SPARK * Every soul now begins as somebody - a private starting truth written at your first meeting * An old wound, an odd habit, a vanity, grown from their real story * It lands in their editable prompt file: read it, rewrite it, erase it
UNDER THE HOOD * The narrator is gone - everything a character lives now passes through their own first-person mind * One deeper memory instead of three lists; 40 exchanges held word for word (was 30) * A live memory gauge under their name, and every memory dial in the mod options * Edit any character's prompt, or the world's, from inside the game - it speaks from the next reply * Tidier window headers, the deep memory as its own page, a Back button everywhere
FIXES * Battle tallies told the truth about who struck down whom * Scouts no longer mistrust the peaceable - a band at peace is named plainly as no threat * The player is no longer mis-gendered in gendered languages
Full model guide: github.com/TraxData313/ImmersiveAI/blob/master/docs/choosing-a-model.md
